title: Schedules
subtitle: Run tests automatically at set times.
empty: No schedules yet. Add one below: pick a comparison file, a time and a daily spending limit.
noTicker: This server cannot start scheduled runs right now (it is offline). Schedules are saved and start once it is back.
hostedLimits: Scheduled comparisons run on your workers. This organization uses {{count}} of {{max}} schedules; each can run at most once every {{min}} minutes.
queued: Started (job {{id}}). Follow it in the jobs panel.

add.title: Add a schedule
add.name: Name
add.evaluationHint: Each run starts a new evaluation with the same agent, benchmarks and gate. It needs a daily spending limit; an evaluation without its own budget gets the limit as its budget.
add.cron: When (cron: minute hour day month weekday)
add.hint: Example: 0 6 * * * runs every day at 06:00. Comparisons with a real model need a total budget (budget.total_usd) and a daily limit at least that large.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: A message is sent for every schedule when results get worse or a run fails. The address is not stored here: save it as a secret (Settings > Secrets) and pick its name.
alerts.noSecrets: No secrets yet. Add the alert address in Settings > Secrets first.

whenWords.manual: It runs only when you press Check now.
whenWords.daily: It checks every day at 06:00 UTC.

canary.created: Drift monitor {{name}} created. Next: record its baseline (the reference result later checks are compared with).

canary.missing: To create the drift monitor, pick an agent, a benchmark, the tasks and at least one model, and set both spending limits (or tick Practice mode).

problem.name: Use lowercase letters, digits, - or _ for the name, at most 48 characters.
problem.tasks: Pick the tasks to check, or choose all tasks.
problem.targets: Add at least one model to watch.
problem.cron: Enter a cron line for the custom schedule.
problem.budget: Set both spending limits, or tick Practice mode.
problem.budgetOrder: The limit per check is above the limit per day, so no check could start.
